free_text.inst.v2.D8:
It opens by telling me it is the whole reading in ordinary words, and then it prints three headings with nothing under them. 'What reads well' is followed by one sentence saying no part of my life is plainly favourable. 'What reads hard' is followed by a colon and white space. That is not a reading, that is a form someone forgot to fill in.

Start with the one thing it stuck its neck out on. It says it is 'unusually negative about your father'. My father was the best thing in that house. He got me the saxophone, he took me to meet Tommy Steele, he was still hustling my records round London in the summer he died. He went in August of '69, of pneumonia, at fifty-six, three weeks after Space Oddity charted, and it broke something in me that has never quite set. If your method is going to be unusual about one thing in twelve, and it picks the one relationship in my life that actually worked, you have put your money on the wrong horse in a two-horse race.

What it calls hard, in a list of eight: health and energy, money and family life, home and property and my mother, illness and debts and rivals, big changes, luck and higher study and my father, income and gains and friends, spending and time away from home and inner life. Eight out of twelve hard and four mixed and nothing good at all. Some of that lands. My mother and I did not speak for years and I did not go to her funeral. My brother Terry lay down in front of a train at Coulsdon South in January '85 and the madness in that family is the thing I have been running from since I was fourteen. My health was a wreck — the eye George put out in '62, the cocaine years in Los Angeles when I was living on peppers and milk and seeing bodies fall past the window, the heart on that German festival stage in June 2004, and then the liver, which is the one that got me. Time away from home, yes: New York, Los Angeles, Switzerland, Berlin. Inner life, yes. But you do not get credit for those when you have marked everything hard. Call every horse lame and you will be right about the ones that limp.

And the misses are on the same page. Income, gains and friends read hard. I sold fifty-five million dollars of bonds against my own back catalogue in 1997, bought my masters back off Defries with it, and left an estate people are still arguing about. Home and property read hard: the Château du Signal above Lausanne, the house I built on Mustique, Lafayette Street, Woodstock. Work and standing only 'mixed'. I turned down a CBE and a knighthood; mixed is not the word. And it says I am talkative. Ask anyone who ever tried to get a sentence out of me at a party — I invented Ziggy because I did not have the nerve to walk out there as David Jones.

The last part is the strangest. 'Right now the method reads a strong stretch', and then it lists money, home, children, marriage, work and income as live. I released Blackstar on my sixty-ninth birthday and died two days later. Nothing has been live for a decade. Whatever your clock is reading, it is not reading me.
free_text.inst.v2.D8.note: Answered in the first person as David Bowie (b. 8 January 1947, 40 Stansfield Road, Brixton; d. 10 January 2016, Manhattan).

notes: Answered as David Bowie from the documented record, having read the short reading first. Birth data: 9:00 GMT, AstroDatabank Rodden A, sourced 'from his parents' via the Gillmans' Alias David Bowie (an earlier 9:15 was superseded in 2015) - hence A1=family_memory, A2=round_hour, A3=no (the 9:15->9:00 change was a source correction, not an astrologer's rectification). Where the reading and the record collided, the record won: (1) it flags itself as 'unusually negative about your father', and the record is the opposite - John Jones was warm, supportive, bought the saxophone, plugged Space Oddity, died 5 Aug 1969 - so C1=opt2 confidence 4 and this is the main entry in D1. (2) It calls 'income, gains and friends' and 'home, property and your mother' hard; income/property are flatly contradicted (Bowie Bonds Feb 1997, catalogue buy-back from Defries, Chateau du Signal 1982, Mandalay on Mustique 1989, Lafayette Street, Woodstock; art collection sold for GBP 32.9m in 2016), so C5/C6/C12=gone well at confidence 4. The 'mother' half of that same line IS right (estrangement, disowned her in the 1980s, absent from her 2001 funeral) - the line is half true because it bundles four unrelated things. (3) It calls 'work and standing' merely mixed; C10=opt2 confidence 5. Where it was right - health, illness, big changes, time away from home, inner life - it was right inside a list that marks eight of twelve matters hard and none good, so I recorded D2 as empty rather than credit a shotgun: no claim in this page is both correct and unguessable. Judgement calls: A4=four_plus and A5=two_plus cover the 1962 eye operations, the June 2004 emergency angioplasty in Hamburg and the 2014-16 cancer treatment, none of them itemised in public sources; A6 includes nerves for the 1975-76 cocaine psychosis and the lifelong fear of the family's schizophrenia rather than any diagnosis; A9=unknown (grandparents' lifespans not documented); A21=net_gain rests on the bonds, the catalogue and the art collection rather than on any documented betting or share trading; A23=serious_past reflects the MainMan years, when he was a superstar on an allowance and the 1975 settlement left Defries 50% of five albums' royalties to 1982, and the 1997 bond issue is reported as clearing his debts; A29=yes because Iman's IVF failed before Lexi was conceived; A31=extended for the LA psychosis, no formal psychiatric treatment on record; A27=happy reads the closest partnership as the Iman marriage (1992-2016) while A24=married is his status at death, with the Angie divorce (Feb 1980) logged at A35 instead; C4=opt1 at confidence 2 is near a coin toss - no inheritance is documented in either direction, and I leaned to difficulty only on the other-people's-money record (the Defries royalty split, the family quarrel around Terry), noting it coincidentally agrees with the reading. A36 is unanswerable as put: he died in January 2016, so both the window since mid-2023 and the six years before it are posthumous - 'same' is the literal truth and the reading's whole 'Right now... a strong stretch' section, with six matters listed as live, is wrong for the same reason. D4 lists the chapters this short page does not contain.
